en.title: Our Story | About TCRFC | Taichung Rock FC
en.description: Taichung Rock FC (TCRFC) was founded in Taichung in 2024. This page will tell the club's story from its founding to today; the full text is still being prepared.

body.zh: 台中磐石足球俱樂部（Taichung Rock FC）於 2024 年在台中成立，同年即拿下全國乙級聯賽冠軍。俱樂部主場設於西屯足球場，以「在地扎根．放眼世界」為品牌主張，逐步建立起一線隊、學院與課程並行的發展體系。
body.en: Taichung Rock FC was founded in Taichung in 2024 and won the National Second Division champions title in its first year. The club's home ground is Xitun Football Field. With “LOCAL ROOTS. GLOBAL PATHWAYS.” as its brand promise, it has steadily built a development system in which the First Team, the Academy and our programs run side by side.

description.en: Starting from Taichung, we develop local players for the professional stage and become a source of local pride.

description.en: Through a solid training system and international connections, we let the world see Taiwan football.

zh.title: 足球理念 Our Philosophy｜關於台中磐石｜台中磐石足球俱樂部
zh.description: 台中磐石足球俱樂部的足球理念與四大核心價值：啟發球員、塑造冠軍、在地驕傲、撼動全球。

en.title: Our Philosophy | About TCRFC | Taichung Rock FC
en.description: The football philosophy and four core values of Taichung Rock FC: Inspiring players, Shaping champions, Local pride and Global influence.

body.zh:
台中磐石足球俱樂部的足球理念，可概括為：以台中在地化為根基，以本土球員培育為核心，以完整青訓、職業化管理、運動科學及國際交流為方法，推動可持續的台灣足球發展。這不是只追求短期成績的球隊定位，而是試圖把俱樂部建成連結社區、學校、青訓與成人競技隊的足球發展平台。以專業模式培育球員，協助其追求卓越、發揮潛能。透過實際行動展示職業足球理念，推動台灣足球的永續發展。

在地化與社區責任
以台中為發展基地，建立地方認同，並把俱樂部定位為推動社區足球、青少年足球與城市運動文化的力量。

完整發展路徑
建立由兒童、學校青訓到成年隊的培養通道，避免球員在特定年齡階段失去銜接機會。

科學化與個別化訓練
用檢測、數據與個人化負荷設計取代只憑經驗的訓練，提升球員體能表現、訓練效率與競技穩定度。

國際視野
學習歐洲、日本與亞洲職業俱樂部的制度與方法，但依台灣教育文化、訓練時間與球員生活現實做在地調整。

建設足球生態
俱樂部不只負責比賽成績，也必須把制度、資源、訓練與基層發展真正帶進球場，主動承擔足球生態建設責任。
body.en:
The football philosophy of Taichung Rock Football Club can be summed up as follows: rooted in Taichung, centred on developing local players, and using a complete youth system, professional management, sports science and international exchange as its methods, to promote the sustainable development of football in Taiwan. This is not a club positioning built only on short-term results, but an attempt to build the club into a football development platform that connects the community, schools, youth development and the adult competitive team. We develop players through a professional model, helping them pursue excellence and fulfil their potential, and we demonstrate professional football principles through concrete action to promote the lasting development of Taiwan football.

Local roots and community responsibility
Taking Taichung as our base, we build local identity and position the club as a force for community football, youth football and the city's sporting culture.

A complete development pathway
We build a pipeline from children's and school youth football up to the adult team, so that players do not lose the link to the next stage at any particular age.

Scientific and individualised training
We replace experience-only training with testing, data and individualised load design, improving players' physical performance, training efficiency and competitive consistency.

International outlook
We learn from the systems and methods of professional clubs in Europe, Japan and elsewhere in Asia, and adapt them locally to Taiwan's education and culture, training hours and the realities of players' lives.

Building the football ecosystem
The club is responsible not only for match results. It must also bring systems, resources, training and grassroots development into football in a real way, and actively take on the responsibility of building the football ecosystem.

description.zh:
足球的價值不只是贏球。台中磐石相信，更重要的是讓每一位球員看見自己的可能。

從第一次碰球的孩子，到站上成人賽場的球員，我們希望給每個人一條清楚的路、一個能持續成長的環境。紀律、責任、團隊合作、面對挫折、尊重對手，這些東西跟技術一樣重要，甚至更難練。

真正的冠軍，不只存在於比分牌上。
description.en:
Football's value goes beyond winning. Taichung Rock believes that what matters more is helping every player see what they could become.

From a child touching a ball for the first time to a player stepping onto the adult pitch, we want to give everyone a clear path and an environment in which they can keep growing. Discipline, responsibility, teamwork, facing setbacks and respecting opponents matter as much as technique, and are often harder to train.

True champions do not exist only on the scoreboard.

description.zh:
冠軍不是一夜練成的，也不只由名次決定。

它來自每天準時到場、每一次不敷衍的訓練、每一個撐下去的決定，還有在團隊裡彼此扛起的責任。贏了之後的謙遜、輸了之後的韌性、壓力來了的冷靜，這些東西，才是我們真正想培養的。

從青訓到一線隊，台中磐石希望建立一套共同的訓練語言和比賽標準。冠軍不是終點，是每天願意比昨天再好一點點的態度。
description.en:
A champion is not made overnight, nor decided by league position alone.

It comes from turning up on time every day, from training that is never half-hearted, from every decision to keep going, and from the responsibility players shoulder for one another in the team. Humility in victory, resilience in defeat and calm under pressure: these are what we truly want to develop.

From the youth teams to the First Team, Taichung Rock wants to build a shared training language and shared match standards. A championship is not an endpoint; it is the attitude of being willing to get a little better than yesterday, every day.

description.zh:
台中磐石選擇以台中為家，不只是地點上的選擇，而是一個承諾。

一支真正有力量的球隊，跟所在的城市、社區、學校、家庭和球迷是連在一起的。我們持續投入青少年足球、校園合作和社區活動，讓更多孩子有機會碰到球，讓更多家庭走進球場，讓更多台中人覺得，這支隊是我們自己的。

在地驕傲不只是球衣上的城市名稱。是球員為台中拚的那口氣，是看台上的那聲吶喊，也是大家一起相信的那件事：台中的足球，可以更好。
description.en:
Taichung Rock chose Taichung as its home, and that is a commitment, not just a choice of location.

A team with real strength is bound up with its city, its communities, its schools, its families and its fans. We keep investing in youth football, school partnerships and community activities, so that more children get the chance to play, more families come into the stadium, and more people in Taichung feel that this team is their own.

Local pride is more than the name of the city on a shirt. It is the effort players give for Taichung, the cheer from the stands, and something we all believe together: football in Taichung can be better.

description.zh:
我們從台中出發，但眼光不只放在台中。

足球是跨越語言和國界的語言。台中磐石透過國際合作、海外交流和教練培訓，讓球員看見世界不同的足球文化，也讓世界慢慢認識台中。

跟不同國家和職業俱樂部的交流，不是為了貼標籤，而是真的想知道高水平足球在要求什麼，細節、紀律、恢復、戰術、人才培育，每一個環節都是功課。我們希望把這些帶回來，轉化成適合台灣球員的東西。

讓每一位從台中磐石出發的球員，都有機會站上更大的舞台。讓每一場在台中踢出的比賽，都成為台灣足球走向世界的下一步。
description.en:
We start from Taichung, but our eyes are not only on Taichung.

Football is a language that crosses languages and borders. Through international cooperation, overseas exchange and coach education, Taichung Rock lets players see different football cultures around the world, and lets the world slowly get to know Taichung.

Exchange with clubs in other countries, including professional clubs, is not about attaching labels; it is about genuinely finding out what high-level football demands. Detail, discipline, recovery, tactics and talent development are all lessons to learn. We hope to bring these back and turn them into something that suits Taiwanese players.

May every player who sets out from Taichung Rock have the chance to step onto a bigger stage, and may every match played in Taichung become the next step for Taiwan football towards the world.

body.zh: 我們認為青少年足球培育是一項長期且循序漸進的發展工程，從個人技術、小組配合到整體戰術逐步建立能力，並依不同年齡階段均衡發展技術、戰術、生理與心理。同時鼓勵球員主動思考、勇於面對與解決問題，培養成熟的球場判斷力與團隊精神。
body.en: We believe that youth football development is a long-term, step-by-step undertaking: ability is built from individual technique and small-group combinations up to overall team tactics, and the technical, tactical, physical and psychological sides are developed in balance at each age stage. We also encourage players to think for themselves and to face and solve problems, building mature on-pitch judgement and team spirit.

body.zh: 台中磐石會提供一個自由、自主且快樂的足球環境，讓球員在不受體育班制度限制的情況下持續發展，也不因學制而被迫中斷足球道路。
body.en: Taichung Rock provides a free, self-directed and enjoyable football environment, so that players can keep developing without being bound by the sports-class system, and without having their football path interrupted by the school system.

body.zh: 採用週期化訓練（年度→月度→週計畫），主題式戰術發展，結合技術、戰術、體能與心理四大面向，並定期評估與個人化回饋，追蹤球員進步軌跡，以此方式循序漸進提升每一位選手。
body.en: We use periodised training (annual, monthly and weekly plans) with theme-based tactical development that combines the four dimensions of technique, tactics, fitness and psychology. Regular assessment and individualised feedback track each player's progress, so that every player improves step by step.

description.en: Cups and leagues organised or recognised by the CTFA, and the U11/12 Victory League

description.en: One overseas competition is planned

description.en: Domestic and overseas training camps arranged according to the training plan

body.zh:
本俱樂部核心理念視青訓發展為長期計劃，「未來仍持續參與本俱樂部青訓課程與球隊動之球員」為優先考量出國參賽對象。我們相信，出國比賽只是長期培訓的一個里程碑，真正重要的是孩子在平日訓練中持續累積的態度、習慣與能力發展。我們也希望在整體培訓規劃下，讓每一位孩子都能有機會參與比賽與國際交流，累積寶貴的實戰與成長經驗。

凡加入本俱樂部培訓體系之青訓球員，賽事代表權皆歸屬於「台中磐石足球俱樂部」。為確保團隊戰術演練之完整性與整體培訓品質，球員須代表本俱樂部參與國內各項賽事（含足協主辦或認可之賽事）。在學期間，賽事註冊與出賽皆以本俱樂部名義為唯一代表，暫不開放跨單位或代表學校參賽，敬請家長與球員理解與配合。
body.en:
The club's core philosophy treats youth development as a long-term plan, and players who "will continue to take part in the club's youth programmes and team activities" are given priority for overseas competitions. We believe that playing abroad is only one milestone in long-term development; what truly matters is the attitude, habits and ability that children build up in everyday training. Within the overall training plan, we also hope every child gets the chance to take part in matches and international exchange and to gain valuable match and growth experience.

Every youth player who joins the club's training system is represented in competition by "Taichung Rock Football Club". To keep team tactical work complete and the overall training quality high, players must represent the club in domestic competitions (including those organised or recognised by the CTFA). While they are in school, competition registration and appearances are made solely in the club's name; representing other organisations or schools is not open for now. We ask parents and players for your understanding and cooperation.

body.zh: 未來將與教育單位合作，向政府申請實驗教育計畫，將足球專業訓練與學業教育整合，術科與學科並重，在生活實作學習環境中，培育更具競爭力的新世代。
body.en: In future we will work with education partners and apply to the government for an experimental education programme, integrating professional football training with academic education, giving equal weight to practical and academic subjects, and developing a more competitive new generation in a learning environment of hands-on living.

description.zh: 尊重教練、隊友與對手，展現良好運動家精神，準時參加訓練與比賽，請假須提前告知，積極投入訓練，主動學習與自我要求
description.en: Respect coaches, teammates and opponents and show good sportsmanship; attend training and matches on time and give notice in advance when absent; commit actively to training; learn proactively and set high standards for yourself.

description.zh:
場邊支持但不干預指揮，信任教練團專業判斷，不在比賽或訓練時對球員或裁判情緒性喊叫
以身作則，示範良好運動家精神。
description.en:
Support from the sideline without interfering with coaching instructions; trust the coaching staff's professional judgement; do not shout emotionally at players or referees during matches or training.
Lead by example and demonstrate good sportsmanship.

description.zh: 遵守訓練與比賽紀律，維護團隊正向氛圍，理解發展性足球理念：過程重於結果，成長重於勝負。
description.en: Observe discipline in training and matches and maintain a positive team atmosphere; understand the developmental football philosophy: process matters more than outcome, and growth matters more than winning or losing.

zh.title: 女子足球 Women's Football｜台中磐石足球俱樂部
zh.description: 台中藍鯨女子隊的介紹與官網入口。完整球員名單、教練陣容、賽程與成績請至台中藍鯨官方網站。

en.title: Women's Football | Taichung Rock FC
en.description: An introduction to the Taichung Blue Whale women's team and the entry point to its official website. For the full squad, coaching staff, fixtures and results, please visit the Taichung Blue Whale official website.

body.zh: 隸屬於臺中市女子足球協會之台中藍鯨女子足球隊，簡稱為台中藍鯨，是台灣木蘭足球聯賽的球隊之一。以「藍鯨」作為象徵，代表追求更快、更堅強、更現代化的足球型態，重視團隊合作，鯨翅為台灣意象代表引領台灣足球向前邁進。台中藍鯨希望能帶動台中足球基層環境風氣，帶動中部地區女子足球的發展。
body.en: The Taichung Blue Whale women's football team belongs to the Taichung City Women's Football Association, is known for short as Taichung Blue Whale, and is one of the teams in the Taiwan Mulan Football League. The blue whale is its symbol of a faster, stronger and more modern way of playing football, with an emphasis on teamwork, and the whale's fin is an emblem of Taiwan, leading Taiwan football forward. Taichung Blue Whale hopes to lift the culture of grassroots football in Taichung and drive the development of women's football in central Taiwan.

zh.title: 成為合作夥伴 Become a Partner｜合作夥伴與贊助｜台中磐石足球俱樂部
zh.description: 了解與台中磐石足球俱樂部合作的六大價值：品牌曝光、受眾觸及、社會影響力與國際發展網絡。

en.title: Become a Partner | Partners & Sponsors | Taichung Rock FC
en.description: Learn about the six values of partnering with Taichung Rock FC: brand exposure, audience reach, social impact and an international development network.

description.zh: 台中磐石是台中在地唯一的企業甲級足球俱樂部，是品牌走進運動與社區場域的直接管道。
description.en: Taichung Rock FC is the only club in Taichung competing in the top-tier corporate league, giving brands a direct route into sport and the local community.

description.zh: 涵蓋一線隊球迷、學院學員家庭與賽事現場觀眾，詳細數據見下方。
description.en: Covers First Team fans, Academy student families and matchday crowds. Detailed figures are below.

description.zh: 球衣、場邊看板、官網與社群通路曝光，讓品牌與職業足球賽事同框。
description.en: Exposure on the kit, pitchside boards, our website and social media channels puts your brand alongside professional football fixtures.

description.zh: 結合社區足球日與慈善活動，讓品牌參與有意義的在地社會實踐。
description.en: Community football days and charity activities let your brand take part in meaningful local social action.

description.zh: 透過學院與課程與家庭、學校建立長期信任關係，擴大品牌口碑觸及。
description.en: Through the Academy and our programs, build long-term trust with families and schools and widen your brand's word-of-mouth reach.

description.zh: 藉由國際交流與海外拓展計畫，讓品牌隨台中磐石球員的腳步走向世界。
description.en: Through international exchange and overseas expansion programs, let your brand travel the world with Taichung Rock FC's players.

body.zh: 完整受眾與社群數據報告可於洽談合作時提供，歡迎聯絡商務部索取最新資料。
body.en: The full audience and social media data report is available when we discuss a partnership. Please contact our Partnerships Department for the latest figures.

zh.title: 慈善理念與投入領域 Our Commitment｜慈善與社會影響｜台中磐石足球俱樂部
zh.description: 台中磐石足球俱樂部的慈善理念與四大投入領域：青少年足球培育、國際教育與運動交流、兒少教育資源、社區與家庭足球。

en.title: Our Commitment and Focus Areas | Charity & Impact | Taichung Rock FC
en.description: The charitable philosophy and four focus areas of Taichung Rock FC: youth football development, international education and sports exchange, educational resources for children, and community and family football.

body.zh: 台中磐石足球俱樂部立足台中，致力推廣足球運動、培育本地選手、深化社區互動及推動青少年足球。俱樂部相信，足球不只是競賽，更是讓兒童與青少年建立自信、紀律、團隊精神及國際視野的重要教育媒介。
body.en: Taichung Rock FC is rooted in Taichung and is committed to promoting football, developing local players, deepening community engagement and advancing youth football. The club believes that football is more than competition: it is an important educational medium through which children and young people build confidence, discipline, teamwork and an international outlook.

body.zh: 台中磐石以實際行動支持基層足球與在地教育：一方面協助具潛力的青少年球員取得跨國交流與訓練機會；另一方面結合企業夥伴，把學習資源帶進校園與幼兒園。俱樂部期望在追求競技成績的同時，承擔社會責任，成為社區中積極、正面的力量。
body.en: Taichung Rock FC supports grassroots football and local education through concrete action: on one hand, helping promising young players gain international exchange and training opportunities; on the other, working with corporate partners to bring learning resources into schools and kindergartens. While pursuing competitive success, the club aims to take on social responsibility and be an active, positive force in the community.

description.zh:
提供基層球員訓練、競賽與國際交流機會。
全額支持潭秀國中與嶺東高中聯隊共 18 名球員、2 名教練赴日本參加第七屆 Felice CUP U16。
description.en:
Providing grassroots players with training, competition and international exchange opportunities.
Fully funded 18 players and 2 coaches from the joint 潭秀國中 and 嶺東高中 squad to attend the 7th Felice CUP U16 in Japan.

description.zh:
透過海外賽事及訓練，擴展青年球員視野與競技經驗。
Felice CUP U16 於日本茨城縣舉行，行程包含 J 聯盟教練指導及後續賽事。
description.en:
Broadening young players' horizons and competitive experience through overseas tournaments and training.
The Felice CUP U16 was held in Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, and included coaching by J.League coaches followed by tournament matches.

description.zh:
以書籍及學習資源支持幼兒教育與成長。
與 Subkarma 捐贈《Cabbage & Tyler》英語幼童學習書籍予潭秀非營利幼兒園。
description.en:
Supporting early childhood education and growth with books and learning resources.
Together with Subkarma, donated the English children's learning books Cabbage & Tyler to 潭秀非營利幼兒園.

description.zh:
透過賽事與互動活動，增加兒少及家庭接觸足球的機會。
2025 台中磐石盃設 U6、U8、U10、U12 組別，並規劃親子與球員互動活動，吸引超過 45 支少年隊伍參加。
description.en:
Increasing children's and families' access to football through matches and interactive events.
The 2025 Taichung Rock FC Cup had U6, U8, U10 and U12 divisions, with parent-child and player-interaction activities planned, and attracted more than 45 youth teams.

zh.title: 我們的故事｜關於台中藍鯨｜台中藍鯨女子足球隊
zh.description: 台中藍鯨女子足球隊 2014 年成立於台中，隸屬臺中市女子足球協會。認識這支球隊的定位與成立宗旨。

en.title: Our Story | About Taichung Blue Whale | Taichung Blue Whale Women's Football Club
en.description: Taichung Blue Whale Women's Football Club was founded in Taichung in 2014 under the Taichung City Women's Football Association. Learn about the team's positioning and founding purpose.

body.zh: 隸屬於臺中市女子足球協會之台中藍鯨女子足球隊，簡稱為台中藍鯨，是台灣木蘭足球聯賽的球隊之一。以「藍鯨」作為象徵，代表追求更快、更堅強、更現代化的足球型態，重視團隊合作，鯨翅為台灣意象代表引領台灣足球向前邁進。台中藍鯨希望能帶動台中足球基層環境風氣，帶動中部地區女子足球的發展。
body.en: Taichung Blue Whale Women's Football Club, part of the Taichung City Women's Football Association and known for short as Taichung Blue Whale, is one of the teams of the Taiwan Mulan Football League. Taking the blue whale as its symbol, it stands for a faster, stronger and more modern style of football with an emphasis on teamwork; the whale's fin is an emblem of Taiwan, leading Taiwan football forward. Taichung Blue Whale hopes to lift the grassroots football culture in Taichung and drive the development of women's football in central Taiwan.

zh.title: 發展願景｜關於台中藍鯨｜台中藍鯨女子足球隊
zh.description: 台中藍鯨女子足球隊的發展願景：無止盡的探索、不怕難的堅韌、更細膩的態度、最真實的影響、更深遠之目的。

en.title: Development Vision | About Taichung Blue Whale | Taichung Blue Whale Women's Football Club
en.description: The development vision of Taichung Blue Whale Women's Football Club: endless exploration, resilience that fears no difficulty, a more refined attitude, the most genuine impact and a deeper purpose.

description.zh: 提昇及普及大台中足球水準，吸收更專業精進足球技術，追上亞洲足球技術水平迎接世界潮流。
description.en: Raise and popularise the standard of football in greater Taichung, absorb more professional and refined football skills, catch up with the technical level of Asian football and meet the global trend.

description.zh: 創造足球運動文化與風氣，以球迷為本讓足球比賽呈現更有水準，場內技術提升，場外足球比賽氛圍更加提升。
description.en: Create a football culture and atmosphere with fans at the centre, so that matches reach a higher standard: better technique on the pitch and a livelier matchday atmosphere off it.

description.zh: 增加足球選手發展管道，讓選手有更好的發展空間，家長支持，學校支持，政府支持，產業支持，民眾支持。
description.en: Widen the pathways for football players so they have more room to develop, with the support of parents, schools, government, industry and the public.

description.zh: 建立台中為台灣足球之都的美名與榮耀，健康正向的足球風氣，連結喜愛足球運動的球迷及選手所追求的足球夢想。
description.en: Build Taichung's reputation and pride as the capital of Taiwan football, with a healthy and positive football culture that connects fans who love the sport with the football dreams that players pursue.

description.zh: 持續回饋社會，致力為人們創造更美好的生活，深信我們能帶來改變，幫助人們以全新的方式彼此分享與連結，讓世界更加和諧。
description.en: Keep giving back to society and strive to create a better life for people. We believe we can bring change, helping people share and connect with one another in new ways and making the world more harmonious.

zh.title: 俱樂部口號與培訓精神｜關於台中藍鯨｜台中藍鯨女子足球隊
zh.description: 台中藍鯨女子足球隊的俱樂部口號與培訓精神，以及隊徽「藍鯨」象徵的設計理念。

en.title: Club Slogan and Training Spirit | About Taichung Blue Whale | Taichung Blue Whale Women's Football Club
en.description: The club slogan and training spirit of Taichung Blue Whale Women's Football Club, and the design concept behind the blue whale on the club crest.

text.zh: 以「藍鯨」作為象徵，代表追求更快、更堅強、更現代化的足球型態、重視團隊合作，鯨翅為台灣意象代表引領台灣足球向前邁進。
text.en: The blue whale is our symbol, representing a faster, stronger and more modern style of football with an emphasis on teamwork; the whale's fin is an emblem of Taiwan, leading Taiwan football forward.

text.zh: 藍色的天空是我們心中夢想的方向，閃爍的陽光是走向夢想的力量，草地上揮灑汗水是成長過往 堅定信仰，有你在身旁 就不再徬徨，此時此刻，我們與我們的球迷站在一起。一起迎向世界。
text.en: The blue sky is the direction of the dreams in our hearts, the glittering sunlight is the strength that carries us towards them, and the sweat shed on the grass is our growth and our steadfast belief. With you by our side we are no longer lost. Right now, we stand together with our fans, and face the world together.

text.zh: 別害怕 勇敢去闖，邁開步伐乘風破浪，就算遍體鱗傷 也要逆風飛翔，抬起頭 夢在前方，越過那重重的高牆 沒有誰能阻擋，眼神越是發光，世界都是我的舞台。
text.en: Do not be afraid; be brave and go for it. Stride forward and ride the waves; even if you are covered in scars, fly into the wind. Lift your head, the dream is ahead. Cross those high walls, and no one can stop us. The brighter our eyes shine, the more the whole world is our stage.

en.title: Become a Partner | Partners & Sponsors | Taichung Blue Whale
en.description: Learn about the six values of partnering with Taichung Blue Whale: brand exposure, audience reach, social impact and an international development network.

description.zh: 台中藍鯨是台灣木蘭聯賽的球隊之一，是品牌走進女子足球與社區場域的直接管道。
description.en: Taichung Blue Whale is one of the teams in the Taiwan Mulan Football League, giving brands a direct route into women's football and the local community.

description.zh: 涵蓋一線隊球迷、青年隊學員家庭與賽事現場觀眾，詳細數據見下方。
description.en: Covers First Team fans, Youth team student families and matchday crowds. Detailed figures are below.

description.zh: 球衣、場邊看板、官網與社群通路曝光，讓品牌與職業足球賽事同框。
description.en: Exposure on the kit, pitchside boards, our website and social media channels puts your brand alongside professional football fixtures.

description.zh: 結合社區足球推廣活動，讓品牌參與有意義的在地社會實踐。
description.en: Community football promotion activities let your brand take part in meaningful local social action.

description.zh: 透過青年隊與推廣活動與家庭、學校建立長期信任關係，擴大品牌口碑觸及。
description.en: Through the Youth team and our community promotion activities, build long-term trust with families and schools and widen your brand's word-of-mouth reach.

description.zh: 藉由國際交流與海外拓展計畫，讓品牌隨台中藍鯨球員的腳步走向世界。
description.en: Through international exchange and overseas expansion programs, let your brand travel the world with Taichung Blue Whale's players.

body.zh: 完整受眾與社群數據報告可於洽談合作時提供，歡迎聯絡商務部索取最新資料。
body.en: The full audience and social media data report is available when we discuss a partnership. Please contact our Partnerships Department for the latest figures.
